meta.method: Similarity is computed per feature space and NEVER collapsed to one number. A space with <4 members on either side returns null rather than a score — this kills the v2 artifact where aurora~search scored 1.0 because both had a single class token. A pair is a CANDIDATE only when >=2 independent spaces agree at >=0.5. Single-space agreement is a known false-positive mode in both directions: alert/toast score high on css because they legitimately share _shared/feedback (correct sharing, not duplication), and the four procedural fields score low on css because they share composables and a substrate rather than classes.
